'''2014 Worlds Day 3 Greg Shaw DS Hunt Down''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 3).

2013 Players Committee sheet. Copies listed on separate numbered lines; ditto marks expanded. (V) follows the sheet checkbox. Line 36 is written Galen's Fighter; dest is Rogue Shadow (no printed Galen's Fighter title).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
